tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250 rgyun gtor yon tan gter mdzod bzhugs so: 1$0000300oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐:1$0000250 nang nub gtor snod bhan+dha rin chen nang: dam rdzas lnga yi gtsang ma'i rdzas bsags pa: 1$0000300raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 1$0000250gis bsreg sbyang bkru ba dang: 1$0000300oṃ āḥhūm̐ 1$0000250gis bdud rtsir byin brlab cing: 1$0000300hūm̐: rang nyid lhar gsal thugs srog sa bon las: lcags kyu'i 'od 'phros bder gshegs rig 'dzin rnams: rang bzhin gnas nas badz+ra sa mā dza: spyan drangs mkha' la pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: rdo rje'i ljags kyis drangs shing gsol bar gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥgu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra i dam ba lin+ta gṛh+ṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi: ma ma shān+tiṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ ba shaṃ mā ra ya sarba karma ku ru ho:1$0000250 de ltar lan bdun nyer gcig brgya la sogs: yang yang byin brlabs bsngo zhing bstab par bya: de nas phud bran rnga gling rol mor bcas: 1$0000300hūm̐: bla ma rig 'dzin bde gshegs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: byin brlabs rmad byung zag med gtor chen 'di: nam mkha' gang bar yid kyis sprul nas 'bul: bdag gi las dang nyon mongs bag chags dang: phyi nang mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad sol: tshe srings dpal skyed 'gro ba dbang du mdzod: nad yams ma mo'i dal kha myur du zlog: rang 'khor bsrung zhing snyan brjod bdud dmag sgrol: lo phyugs rgyas shing 'jig rten dmag tshogs zlog: rtag tu bde zhing dga' bde 'phel bar mdzod: 1$0000250ces brjod 1$0000300badz+ra muḥ1$0000250yis gshegs su gsol: las rnams grub byed gtor ma'i cho ga 'di: pad+ma bdag gis phyi rabs don du bkod: mtsho rgyal 'gro ba'i don du yi ger thob: s+ya/mya/y+ya/: rgya rgya rgya: tshogs gtor yon tan gter mdzod bzhugs so: 1$0000300 oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐:1$0000250

sgrub thabs yon tan gter mdzod las: dgos pa'i cha rkyen tshogs gtor ni: gtor ma pad+ma spungs pa la: dar gyi rgyan dang bcas pa'i mthar: phyi nang tshogs gtor rgya chen bsham: mkha' 'gro lnga yi gtor ma yang: cha lnga 'am ni snod gcig tu: zhi rgyas dbang drag gang byas la: mtha' ma mtheb kyus brgya brgyad bskor: phyi nang bka' srung dam can gyi: gtor ma dag kyang bsham par bya: khyad par yul de'i gzhi bdag gi: gtor ma bshos gtsang mdzes pa la: gtsang ma'i phud dang bcas te bsham: de nas bdag bskyed yi dam gyi: nga rgyal drag po byas nas ni: 1$0000300raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 1$0000250gi 'phro 'du las: gtor ma'i nyes skyon dri ma sbyangs: 1$0000300oṃ āḥhūm̐ 1$0000250gi byin gyis brlabs: de nas rnga dang rol mo kun: dkrol zhing spos bsreg ting 'dzin spar: gdung zhing snyan pa'i gdung dbyangs kyis: tshogs zhing spyan 'dren bya ba ni: 1$0000300hūm̐: bla ma rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro ma: dpa' bo ging dang srung mar bcas: dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas rnams: tshogs dang gtor ma'i mgron la spyon: gnas mchog dam pa nyams re dga': bde ldan pad+ma bkod pa'i zhing: tshogs mchod gtor ma mdangs dang ldan: dpal ldan mdzes pa'i pho brang yin: 'dir tshogs rnal 'byor nyams re dga': mngon par dga' ba'i gnas su gcig: 'dod yon re skong lhun gyis grub: las rab rdzogs pa'i gnas chen 'dir: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: 'og min gnas dang po ta la: o rgyan gnas nas gshegs su gsol: rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: mngon dga'i zhing nas 'di ru byon: thor tshugs rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan: mdangs ldan mang po'i 'khor bcas gshegs: rin chen rigs kyi ḍā ki ma: dpal ldan zhing nas 'di ru byon: dar dpyangs rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan: mdangs ldan mang po'i 'khor bcas gshegs: pad+ma rigs kyi ḍā ki ma: bde ldan zhing nas 'di ru byon:

g.yer kha dril bu'i rgyan gyis brgyan: mdangs ldan mang po'i 'khor bcas gshegs: las kyi rigs kyi ḍā ki ma: las rab zhing nas 'di ru byon: rus rgyan dur khrod rgyan gyis brgyan: mdangs ldan mang po'i 'khor bcas gshegs: bud+dha rigs kyi ḍā ki ma: chos kyi dbyings nas 'di ru byon: sna tshogs mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan: mdangs ldan mang po'i 'khor bcas gshegs: gnas yul dur khrod brgyad kyi zhing: phyogs mtshams steng 'og thams cad nas: las dang ye shes grub pa yi: mkha' 'gro zhing skyong gnas 'dir gshegs: bka' nyan dam tshig gnyan po'i zhing: chos skyong dam can 'khor dang bcas: las dang dam tshig skyong ba rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī badz+ra sa ma ya dza: hūm̐: pho brang yid 'ong mdzes pa'i zhing khams 'dir: bla ma bde gshegs ḍā ki dam can rnams: bdag dang 'gro la brtse ba'i zhal bstan phyir: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: pad+ma tsan+d+ra sūr+ya s+t+waṃ: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid: gu ru pad+ma'i sku la 'dud: sna tshogs gang 'dul re ba skong: bde gshegs rig 'dzin rnams la 'dud: dam tshig rjes gcod dngos grub ster: ḍā ki ma tshogs rnams la 'dud: bka' srung 'khor skyong dam nyams sgrol: dam can srung ma'i tshogs la 'dud: na mo pu ru sha ya ho:1$0000250 tshogs phud 'bul ba ni: 1$0000300hūm̐: stong gsum rnam dag rin chen snod nang du: ting 'dzin byin brlabs rmad byung zag med rdzas: ar+ghaṃ me tog mar me dri chab dang: zhal zas rol mo mchod sprin rnams kyis mchod: hūm̐: gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim ro mngar zhing: reg 'jam chos dbyings tshogs dang gtor ma'i rdzas: nam mkha'i khams kun gang ba'i ting 'dzin gyis: rje btsun gu ru 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: hūm̐: tsan dan gur gum ga pur gla rtsi dang: gser dngul zangs lcags mu tig bye ru bcas:

sha lnga bdud rtsi dpal gyi gtor ma dang: sman raka brgyan pa'i mchod sprin sna tshogs 'bul: hūm̐: yang dag rtogs pa'i ye shes rnam pa lnga: zhi gnas lhag mthong ting 'dzin bsam mi khyab: dge bcu rnam dag spyod pa'i dgyes mchod 'di: rje btsun gu ru 'khor bcas bzhes su gsol: ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi:1$0000250 bshags pa ni: 1$0000300na mo: bdag dang khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi: lus ngag yid ni bag med dbang gyur te: rig 'dzin bde gshegs mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig dang: 'gal bar gyur pa thams cad mthol lo bshags: phud dang tshogs gtor rgyu chung gtsang sbra nyams: ting 'dzin mi gsal sngags kyi grwa nyams te: 'khor ba'i las bsags sdig sgrib mthol zhing bshags: ye shes spyan mnga' ma bsgribs kun tu gsal: bdag ni ma gus le lo bag med dang: nyon mongs dbang gyur dug lnga'i las bsags pa: ye shes thugs rje'i brtse bas nyer dgongs nas: mthol bshags tshangs pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma ha ri ni sa e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe sarba bi shud+dhe swā hā:1$0000250 zhes brjod de tshogs kyi longs spyod gtor ma bstab cing brgya stong du bskang ngo: des ni tshogs rdzogs sgrib byang bar chad sel: rtag tu 'di la nan tan bya ba gces: s+ya/mya/y+ya/: rgya/rgya/rgya/: ྈ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro bskul zhing dam bdar yon tan gter mdzod bzhugs: s+ya/mya/y+ya/: rgya/rgya/rgya/: 1$0000300 oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐:1$0000250 rig 'dzin bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'dud: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro bskul zhing las bcol na: sngon du sman rag gtor ma'i tshogs bsgoms la: nang du zag med 'dod yon drug tu brlab: ting 'dzin gzengs bstod dbyangs kyis 'di skad do: 1$0000300hūm̐: rig 'dzin bla ma rnam bzhi dgongs su gsol: mkha' 'gro dam can ma lus 'dir gshegs shig:

dam rdzas rmad byung dpal gyi gtor chen 'di: ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zlas brgyan: lha mi'i longs spyod rgya mtsho'i gting ltar zab: spyan gzigs dar 'phan nam mkha'i skar ltar bkram: 'dod yon drug ldan gtor mas thugs dam bskang: sman raka rgya mtsho'i klong yangs 'khyil pa la: ro bcud dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs: ting 'dzin dgongs rgyud dag pas byin gyis brlabs: bla ma rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang: zhing chen bla bre dar gyi 'phan lding dang: rnga dang gling bu gsur chen dud par bcas: spos dang zhal zas zhun chen mar me yis: bla ma rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang: sna bdun rgyal srid bkra shis dag pa'i rdzas: ri gling khor yug lha mi'i longs spyod dang: bu dang bu mo rigs ldan mang po yis: bla ma rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang: sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang ye shes lnga: sku lnga chos lnga rang bzhin dag pa'i rdzas: kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho yis: bla ma rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang: dbyer med dag mnyam rtogs pa'i dgyes mchod 'dis: phyogs bcu dus gsum bla ma yi dam lha: mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can srung ma'i tshogs: sde brgyad rigs drug lan chags bgegs rigs dang: khas nyen dbang chung glo bur lhags pa'i mgron: thams cad ma lus sku dang ye shes kyi: rol pa chen po chos sku'i klong du bskang: dngos dang dngos med blo la snang ba yi: mchod sprin tshogs kyi mchod pas thugs dam bskang: thams cad stong nyid ye shes chen po'i ngang: rtog tshogs rang grol ye shes thugs dam bskang: gsal ba shes rab sdug bsngal bde chen ngang: skye 'gag gnyis med rol pa'i klong du bskang: thugs dam bskangs la mchog dang thun mong gi: dngos grub dam pa dus 'dir bstsal du gsol: sarba ga ṇa tsa kra pū dza khā hi:1$0000250 de nas sgo gsum sdig la 'gyod sems kyis:

1$0000300e ma ho: rang bzhin dag pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi: lha dang rig 'dzin srung ma dgongs su gsol: bdag cag ma rig sgo gsum las dbang gi: bag med tshul gyis bsags pa'i sdig pa rnams: kun bzang chos dbyings rol pa'i klong du bshags: rdo rje slob dpon mched lcam dam pa'i chos: skur smad log rtog dbang gis spangs pa dang: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig sdom las 'gal: don dam chos nyid dag pa'i klong du bshags: tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī satwa sa ma ya:1$0000250 zhes sogs brjod nas yig brgya mang du bzla: de nas rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i bskul pa ni: 1$0000300hūm̐ hūm̐: ma g.yel ma g.yel bla ma rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos dbyings bde chen ngang nas bzhengs: bskul lo bskul lo 'gro ba'i don du thugs rje rab tu bskul: nam mkha'i mtha' ltar zhing khams bsam las 'das: gdul bya'i re ba kun tu skong mdzad pa: o rgyan sprul pa bye ba phrag brgya'i tshogs: bdag cag bod kyi sems can don la bskul: thugs rje ma chung sngon gyi thugs dam dgongs: bla ma rig 'dzin skar tshogs chems se chem: yi dam lha tshogs phyag rgya lams se lam: mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro sprin ltar thibs se thib: hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrog di ri ri: ging chen dpa' bos bro brdung khrabs se khrab: bdud dang 'gong po phye mar nya la la: chos skyong dam can ser chen sha ra ra: dam nyams log lta'i bdud dpung choms se chom: bdag dang khams gsum 'gro ba'i nad gdon rnams: thugs rje'i chu yis sbyangs shing bkru bar mdzod: las dang nyon mongs shes bya'i sdig sgrib rnams: ye shes me yis bsreg cing sbyang du gsol: tshe dang dbang thang longs spyod snyan dang grags: ting 'dzin lus stobs ye shes rgyas par mdzod: rgyal po btsun mo blon po dmag mi dang:

lha 'dre ma lus dbang bsdus zil gyis non: bdud dang mu stegs dgra bgegs zhing bcu'i tshogs: mthu rtsal chen pos thal ba'i rdul du rlog: hūm̐: dbus phyogs dga' ldan zhing khams nas: sangs rgyas rigs kyi ḍā ki ma: dkar mo 'bum sde dbyings nas bzhengs: bde chen ye shes phrin las mdzod: ha: shar phyogs mngon dga'i zhing khams nas: rdo rje rigs kyi ḍā ki ma: sngon mo 'bum sde dbyings nas bzhengs: zhi ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ri: lho phyogs dpal ldan zhing khams nas: rin chen rigs kyi ḍā ki ma: ser mo 'bum sde dbyings nas bzhengs: rgyas pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ni: nub phyogs bde ldan zhing khams nas: pad+ma rigs kyi ḍā ki ma: dmar mo 'bum sde dbyings nas bzhengs: dbang gi phrin las 'grub par mdzod: sa: las rnams lhun grub zhing khams nas: karma rigs kyi ḍā ki ma: ljang mo 'bum sde dbyings nas bzhengs: drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hrī: gnas yul nyer bzhi dur khrod brgyad: gnas gzhugs mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dang: dam can srung ma thams cad dang: gter bdag las byed dbyings nas bzhengs: nad gdon dgra bgegs gnod pa zlog: sri langs bdud gcod ru 'dzing dang: mo ngan ngan sdig thams cad zlog: ltas ngan ye 'drog cho 'phrul zlog: dgra dpung bgegs kyi sbyor ba zlog: oṃ shān+tiṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ pa shaṃ mā ra ya pra mo ha: rbod zor bh+yo bh+yo:1$0000250 de nas gtor ma phyir bskyed la: sman raka chu gtsang bran byas te: bdag nyid gu rur gsal byas la: pad zhwa chos gos phod chen gsol: rdo rje phur pa phyar byas te: 1$0000300hūm̐: sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: 'og min dga' ldan gnas mchog tu: rdo rje khrag 'thung skur bstan nas: dam la btags pa'i mkha' 'gro ging: dbang phyug ma sring 'bar ma dang: pho nya las mkhan dam tshig can: chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon: dam ldan rgyan gyi gtor ma longs:

bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: hūm̐: yang le shod kyi brag phug tu: rdo rje 'chang gi skur bstan nas: dam la btags pa'i gtsang rigs kyi: mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga'i tshogs: chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon: dam ldan rgyan gyi gtor ma longs: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: hūm̐: rgya gar dur khrod gnas brgyad du: bka' brgyad khrag 'thung skur bstan nas: dam la btags pa'i zhing skyong dang: bka' srung mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs: chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon: dam ldan rgyan gyi gtor ma longs: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: hūm̐: tsha shod mang yul dpal mo'i mtshor: dbang chen rol pa'i skur bstan nas: dam la btags pa'i dge bsnyen dang: phud bdag brtan ma bcu gnyis tshogs: chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon: dam ldan rgyan gyi gtor ma longs: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: hūm̐: sil ma la dang 'u yug dang: mal gro gung sogs bod yul du: o rgyan pad+ma'i skur bstan nas: dge bsnyen byang btsan 'brog mo dang: gnyan chen la sogs dam tshig can: chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon: dam ldan rgyan gyi gtor ma longs: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: has po ri dang lho brag dang: sham po gangs dang mkha' ri gangs: ti se gangs la gu ru yis: sde brgyad sna tshogs dam la btags: chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon: dam ldan rgyan gyi gtor ma longs: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: mchims phu shel brag stag tshang dang: yang rdzong mkhar chu kong yul dang: khams dang bcas pa'i bod yul du: dam la btags pa'i lha srin tshogs: chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon: dam ldan rgyan gyi gtor ma longs: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: bsam yas khra 'brug lha sa dang: zab lung ti sgro la sogs par: dam la btags pa'i lha srin tshogs: chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon: dam ldan rgyan gyi gtor ma longs: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod:

gu ru o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling: zangs mdog dpal rir srin po'i skur: bzhengs nas dam la btags pa yi: srin po'i gdon tshogs ma lus kun: chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon: dam ldan rgyan gyi gtor ma longs: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: hūm̐: nga ni pad+ma 'byung gnas yin: sku gsung thugs ni rdo rjer gsal: nga yis dbang du bsdus pa las: su yang dam las ma 'da' zhig: gal te dam las 'das gyur na: nga ni yak+sha me dbal sku: dmar nag dbu dgu 'jigs byed zhal: g.yas dgu'i phyag gis rdo rje gzir: g.yon dgu'i phyag gis sdig pa 'gyed: dam nyams snying rtsa bcad nas kyang: khrag rgyun rtag tu 'thung bar byed: de bas dam la ma 'da' bar: bod yul bstan pa srung ba dang: mtha' yi dmag dpung phyir la zlog: nad gdon gnod pa srung ba dang: o rgyan nga yi gter rnams srungs: khri srong lde'u btsan rgyud pa skyongs: sad ser mu ge shwa chu sdoms: btsa' dang skya yug dal yams zlog: dmag 'khrugs byad kha phur kha zlog: dus su char phob 'bru phyugs spel: rigs rgyud bu nor spel ba dang: dam chos klog bshad sgrub brgyud spel: mdo rgyud bstan bcos dar ba dang: dge 'dun sde dpung thos bsam dar: 'jig rten legs dgu kun 'grub mdzod: sa ma ya dam las ma 'da' zhig:1$0000250 ces gtor ma 'bul: de ltar dam bsgrag bya ba'i phyir: sngon du bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin nas: bya ba gang la gang dgos sbyor: mkhar 'debs yul bzung shwa ser bzlog: sde bzung srid bzung chos srid spel: gang la'ang 'di yis don 'grub 'gyur: zhes gsungs so: s+ya/mya/y+ya/: rgya/rgya/rgya/:
